comparison: Original: a large notched dart arrowhead pointing left beside a circled W. Rejected drawing: a plain triangle whose vertical back edge sat against the W's vertical left leg, so the pair read as 'dW' instead of arrow + W; the arrow notch and the circle were both missing.
change: Arrow redrawn as the reference's notched dart (tip 4,24, back corners 20,10/20,38, notch 17,24), sized to match the letter; W kept as a 16-wide full-height glyph with its apex at 22 and an 8-unit clear gap from the arrow back, so the two read as separate symbols.
visual_review: Compared with the original and an earlier triangle attempt (attempt-1-triangle/); checked 48px light and dark previews: dart silhouette and W both legible.
omissions: circle around the W (no width budget: a W at stroke 4 needs a ring of r>=18)
